The '''Old Hallet prairie''' was an area of grassland located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dolva Prime/Legends|Dolva Prime]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. The grassland was dotted with clusters of large [[Color/Legends|purple]] crystalline shards, which jutted up out from the green [[Grass/Legends|grass]] of the region. In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] ambushed the Strom brothers, [[Edo Strom|Edo]] and [[Rolu Strom|Rolu]], while they were passing through the prairie in a [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]]. Fett destroyed the landspeeder and took the artifact known as the [[Arachedron sculpture]], which the brothers had been carrying, and destroyed it. The sculpture, which had been a fake, was designed to contain a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] of the true artifact's location. Fett then made the brothers chain themselves to their burning speeder and left them in the prairie, although they eventually escaped.<ref name="BFatSoF" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Old Hallet prairie first appeared in ''[[Star Wars Adventures: Boba Fett and the Ship of Fear]]'', a [[Star Wars comic books|graphic novella]] written by [[Jeremy Barlow]], penciled by [[Daxiong]],<ref name="BFatSoF" /> and released by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[April 27]], [[2011]] as part of the [[Star Wars Adventures (graphic novels)|''Star Wars Adventures'']] series.<ref name="Dark Horse">{{DarkHorse|url=Books/16-619/Star-Wars-Adventures-Boba-Fett-and-the-Ship-of-Fear|text=Star Wars Adventures: Boba Fett and the Ship of Fear}}</ref>
